label: b2-s71200-memcard
question: I have a product that uses a Siemens Simatic s7-1200 PLC. My company did not write the PLC program, but we have the program on an SD card. We usually are working on existing products that are sent to us for repair, and our procedure is to install the SD card, power on the PLC and it loads the program from the card. Once the light blinking is done, the program is loaded and away we go. We are now building the product from scratch, so the PLC has never been powered on before. We tried the same procedure to load the program from the memory card, but didn't have any luck. Does the PLC need to be setup or configured first, before you can load the program from the memory card? If anyone has any helpful articles or youtube videos, I would appreciate it. I have been looking, but haven't found anything yet.   Like Reply

answer:
The manual says the CPU must be in STOP before you insert the program card, and then you must power-cycle the CPU to evaluate the memory card [5]. If the card is inserted while the CPU is in RUN, the CPU switches to STOP and the MAINT LED flashes to show the card needs to be evaluated [5].

I don’t see any excerpt saying the PLC needs a separate setup or configuration first; the loaded documentation only covers the card-insert and power-cycle behavior [5].
